title: Symmetrically pumped charges with high confinement stiffness for boosted performance in wave energy harvesting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5961-5972
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01158B, Paper
Huijing Qiu, Weizhi Song, Zichao Deng, Zhong Lin Wang, Liang Xu
A symmetrical charge pumping method and a new control parameter for device performance termed as confinement stiffness are reported, which increased the energy harvesting performance of a TENG for practical slow waves.
